title: New Update Available (v1.0.3+18)
message: Updated to Navodaya Pattern, Full Website CMS with Add/Edit/Delete, and performance fixes.
releaseNotes:
• Replaced CBSE pattern with Navodaya Pattern & Govt. Recognized
• Full Website CMS Management integration (Notices, Banners, Marquee, Gallery, Leadership, Reviews)
• Complete Add, Edit, and Delete controls directly within the mobile app
• Zoomable photo gallery with albums
• 32-bit (v7a) and 64-bit (v8a) hardware architecture detection fix
